```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
library(lmtest)
library(car)
library(lm.beta)
library(lavaan)
library(semTools)
library(psych)
library(GPArotation)
library(BifactorIndicesCalculator)
library(MVN)
library(polycor)
library(rsample)
```

```{r}
caff_revised_exploratory <- read_csv("data/raw/caffeine_sensitivity_clean copy.csv") %>%
  filter(if_all(caff_intox_revised_1:caff_intox_revised_12, ~ !is.na(.))) %>%
  select(age, gender, caff_sens, caffeine_perday)
```

```{r}
caff_revised_exploratory %>%
  count(gender)
```

```{r}
caff_revised_exploratory %>%
  summarise(
    mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
caff_revised_exploratory %>%
  count(caff_sens)
```

```{r}
caff_revised_exploratory %>%
  count(caffeine_perday)
```

```{r}
caff_exploratory <- read_csv("data/raw/caffeine_sensitivity_clean copy.csv") %>%
  mutate(start_date = as.Date(start_date)) %>%
  filter(start_date < as.Date("2025-05-21")) %>%
  select(age, gender, caff_sens, caffeine_perday)
```

```{r}
caff_exploratory %>%
  count(gender)
```

```{r}
caff_exploratory %>%
  summarise(
    mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_age = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
caff_exploratory %>%
  count(caff_sens)
```

```{r}
caff_exploratory %>%
  count(caffeine_perday)
```

caff_sens_english <- read_csv("data/raw/caffeine_sensitivity_english_clean.csv") %>%
